answer: Mechanism: every answer must embed a signed receipt of the verification work you did last epoch - the batch ids you countersigned, hashed together. A freshly minted identity has no receipt and must earn one first, so each clone costs a full round of unpaid attestation labour before it can even answer. That is the anchor holding the scheme: identity weight rides on past labour, not on a registration form. Fakes enter only by climbing the same terrace of work, one tier per epoch, and a farm needs one ladder per identity - a willow with no season behind it bears nothing.
